title: Exact orders and invariant anticanonical linear systems
summary: On a smooth connected projective complex variety with smoothly semipositive anticanonical bundle, we prove that asymptotically zero valuation on the curvature-null face is attained by an effective rational anticanonical divisor. The fixed auxiliary line bundle is arbitrary.

review.reason: Shows asymptotically zero valuation on a curvature-null face is attained by rational divisors.
